name: Pumi hero-district kit (Runner of the Tablet House)
generated: scripts/streets/kit (Blender 5.2 build scripts) + pack.ts; sources in LICENSES.md

conventions.units: metres; glTF Y-up; a piece faces +Z (its exterior / front); x runs along a wall run
conventions.pivots: baked into each mesh: every node sits at the origin with identity transform; see each piece's pivot
conventions.lods: nodes <name> (LOD0), <name>_LOD1, <name>_LOD2; suggested switch distances in lodDistances (m, desktop; halve on phones)
conventions.vertexColors: COLOR_0 (multiply into base colour per glTF): baked contact occlusion, grime, tint. GLTFLoader enables it.
conventions.textures: KTX2 (KHR_texture_basisu): load with KTX2Loader (three/examples/jsm/loaders/KTX2Loader + basis transcoder). Geometry: EXT_meshopt_compression, set GLTFLoader.setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder). Normals, UVs and colours use KHR_mesh_quantization; positions are float.
conventions.tiers: hi = <pack>.gltf (desktop, 2K hero textures, UASTC normals); lo = <pack>.lo.gltf (phones, 1K, ETC1S). Both share <pack>.bin (LOD1 and LOD2 geometry) and <pack>.lod0.bin (LOD0 only, loaded only when a LOD0 node is), and reference shared textures in tex/hi or tex/lo; same nodes and pivots in both.
conventions.instancing: each piece is one mesh with 1-3 primitives (one per material); draw with InstancedMesh per primitive, or merge per cell by material (all pieces share a handful of materials).
conventions.houses: world.houses footprints are continuous (3.6-7.8 m a side, walls 3.4-5.3 m tall, roof slab 0.4 m). Reference implementation: scripts/streets/kit/viewer.html house(). Per side, in order front, right, back, left, each side frame turned +90 deg about y from the last (x runs along the side from its start corner, exterior +Z, the footprint toward -Z): corner_out at x = 0; wall modules filling x 0.5 .. L-0.5, stretched along x by (L-1)/sum(widths) (keep 0.9-1.1); for walls taller than 3.0 m stack wallband_* (1 m each) and cornerband at y = 3, 4, ... and stretch y so the last band ends at the wall top; at the wall top y = Hw: roof_edge_corner at x = 0, roof_edge_2m filling 0.5 .. L-0.5, beam_ends_2m (optional, long sides) the same; in the frame offset by (-0.1, Hw+0.4, +0.1): parapet_corner at the origin, parapet_2m / parapet_2m_b filling 0.26 .. L+0.2-0.26. roof_field_2m tiles fill the inner rectangle 0.5 .. W-0.5 by 0.5 .. D-0.5 at y = Hw (their surface is y = Hw + 0.4). Doors: door_leaf_s in door_2m at (0.49, 0, -0.34), door_leaf_l pairs in door_3m at (0.77, 0, -0.34) and (2.23, 0, -0.34) mirrored; rotate about y to open (inward, toward -z).
conventions.uvs: tileable materials map 1 UV unit = tile_m (2 m) from each piece's pivot, so runs of 2 m and 4 m modules tile seamlessly; a 1 m module or a corner leaves a texture phase step at its far end unless the next piece's u is offset by the run's phase so far (sum of nominal widths / 2), as the game does (atlas/src/game/streets/world/assemble.ts); brick courses stay level (v is height). Stretching scales the texture with the piece.
conventions.tint: COLOR_0 holds baked occlusion and grime; per-house plaster tint goes on top as an instance colour (three multiplies instanceColor x vertex colour x map). Props carry their own tint in COLOR_0 (see each piece's extras).
conventions.collision: pieces are visual; collide with simple boxes: a wall piece is x 0..W, y 0..H, z -T..0; parapets x 0..W, y 0..0.55, z -0.26..0; stair_flight a wedge from (0,0) to (3.36, 3.0) over z 0..1.

M_ClayRaw.notes: unfired clay; v 0.25..1 body (periodic in v), v 0..0.25 four tablet faces (blank, faint ruled lines, stylus pocks, thumb-smoothed)

M_Textile.notes: plain-woven linen, near white: COLOR_0 carries the dye (and the integrator may tint per instance)

M_TextilePattern.notes: four whole-cloth woven designs in quadrants (u0 v0 u1 v1): zigzag 0 .5 .5 1, stripes .5 .5 1 1, lozenge 0 0 .5 .5, stepped .5 0 1 .5; invented motifs only

M_StructMisc.notes: trim: v bands rope 0.5-1 (u = 0.12 m of rope), leather 0.25-0.5, bronze 0.125-0.25 (metalness from ORM.b), fired clay 0-0.125

M_Foliage.notes: alpha cut-out foliage atlas (regions in textures_veg.py REGIONS): palm half-fronds, reeds, fig leaf clusters, grass, weeds. Cards are emitted front and back with their own normals, so the material is single-sided.

M_PalmTrunk.notes: date-palm trunk: leaf-base stubs, tileable; u wraps once round the trunk, v = height / 1.4 m

M_Bark.notes: smooth grey fig bark, tileable 1 m

pieces.notes: woven cloth with the 'lozenge' band design folded over a line, soft folds; string several on a rope between poles

pieces.name: cloth_hang_d
pieces.pivot: the line at the top of the fold (the cloth hangs over a line along x through the origin; its longer side toward +Z)
pieces.notes: plain linen dyed saffron folded over a line, soft folds; string several on a rope between poles

pieces.name: cloth_line
pieces.pivot: base centre between the two poles on the ground; the line runs along x
pieces.notes: a drying line: two poles and a sagging rope with four cloths (two woven designs, indigo and saffron linen) folded over it

pieces.name: scale
pieces.pivot: the post's foot on the ground; the arm and pans toward +x
pieces.notes: the weigher's scale: a post with an arm, a balance beam hung on a cord, two bronze pans on three cords each, barrel-shaped weights (dark stone) on a pan and on the ground

pieces.notes: date palm, ~11.5 m overall (trunk 6.8 m): curved trunk of leaf-base stubs, 38 fronds and a skirt of dead ones

download.note: bytes on the wire before HTTP compression (gzip shrinks the .gltf JSON ~5x; .bin and .ktx2 are already compressed). LOD0 geometry is in <pack>.lod0.bin (geometryLod0), fetched only by a viewer that draws LOD0; the game draws LOD1 and LOD2.
